title: OaksMC
description: OaksMC is a minecraft network with alot of different gamemodes
body:
🌳 OaksMC Network | The Ultimate Minigames Experience
Looking for your new favorite place to play?

OaksMC is a premier Minecraft Server Network designed for players who crave the fast-paced, competitive action of giants like Hypixel, but want a fresh community and lag-free performance. Whether you are a sweat trying to climb the leaderboards or a casual player looking for fun, OaksMC is the place for you.

🚀 Why Choose OaksMC?
We’ve taken the best Minigames and polished them to perfection. Our network is built on high-end hardware to ensure the lowest ping and the smoothest gameplay possible.

⚔️ Classic BedWars: Protect your bed, gather resources, and dominate the floating islands with unique shop upgrades and tactical maps.

☁️ Insane SkyWars: Fast looting, high-stakes combat, and epic projectiles. Every second counts!

🏅 Competitive Ranking: Track your stats with our global leaderboards. Level up and earn exclusive rewards as you climb the ranks.

🎭 Custom Cosmetics: Stand out in the lobby with unique hats, trails, and gadgets.

🛡️ Fair Play & Active Staff: Our dedicated team and advanced anti-cheat ensure a toxic-free and fair environment for everyone.

💎 Join the Community
OaksMC isn't just a server; it's a growing family. We host weekly events, community tournaments, and we listen to your feedback to shape the future of the network.

📍 How to Connect:
Server IP: play.oaksmc.xyz

Supported Versions: 1.8 - 1.21+ (Optimized for 1.21 Combat)

Discord: https://discord.gg/aqkcbpVNVs

Store: https://store.oaksmc.xyz

Join OaksMC today and start your journey to the top!
